pr.body:
This archive makes 37 generated Shan Hai Jing identity candidates reviewable in GitHub: the 29-theme Southern Mountains batch plus eight further themes. It includes two-view transparent raster sheets, exact generation prompts, revision notes, all 18 chapters' passage audit artifacts and a consolidated theme catalogue. It also recovers the earlier Cal study that was pending GitHub upload.

The original Shan Hai Jing R01 batch is retained as superseded history. Current candidates are not user-approved, and the deployed character collection is unchanged. Kaiming (039) still fails the required nine-head anatomy and remains pending revision. Lu Wu (038) R03 was reviewed as having nine visible tail tips in both views, but is not user-approved. Two views on one raster sheet are not separate vector assets.

Latest fixed source snapshot: `60e4e5ffc89face7ff92d2e87e9958e906059385`. Earlier archived sources are `17213fe23921222338821bbc6dd485ae3fb39cfd` and `d9b9e8d151eaff5a1b881389b4c5423d8d358b11`. Every uploaded blob SHA matched its local Git object, and each remote tree exactly matched the corresponding local snapshot tree. The latest increment contains 50 changed files and 15 valid RGBA PNGs; all changed JSON files parsed successfully.

Figma synchronization has its own node-level confirmation and pending status in the manifest; GitHub archival does not establish Figma completion. Whole-book identity deduplication, disputed names, remaining anatomy checks and the full character-generation queue are still pending. This PR does not claim the entire Shan Hai Jing artwork collection is complete.
pr.title: Archive 37 Shan Hai Jing yokai candidates and full-book research
